title: Mbënd mu Mag mi
intro: Nit kooku moo nekkoon ponku muñ ci diiru xarnu yu bari, di woo askan wuy xeex ngir ñu ñëw ci leeralu dëgg gi, fekk ñu ngi ko doon ñaawal ak di ko bañ. Doonte jafe-jafe yi bariwoon nañu lool, te bataaxal bi dafa diis lool, surga bi wéy di liggéey ba keroog ñuy génne dogal bu mujj bi.
clues: Def naa juróom-ñeenti téeméeri at ak juróom-fukk, di woo samay askan ci yoonu njub, guddi ak bëccëg, ci lu nëbbu ak lu feeñ.
Àrtu naa sama askan ci mbugal mu metti, waaye ñu def seeni baraam ci seeni nopp, ñu muur seen yéere ngir réylu.
Dañu ma sant ma tabax lu rëy ci sama Boroom, doonte amul woon ndox ci kanam.
Bi may liggéey, njiiti sama askan dañu daan romb di ma ñaawal, waaye ma ne leen, yàggul dara, nun lañuy ñaawal.
Ma ñaan sama yaram ak sama deret ñu ànd ak man, waaye ñu tànn dem rëcci ci tundu wi, ndax dañu gëmoon ni loolu moo leen di muccal ci ndox mi.
Sama gaal mujjee taxaw ci Tundu Judi ginaaw bi suuf si wanne ndoxam, asamaan bi bàyyi taw bi.

arabic: وَقِيلَ يَـٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَـٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it [i.e., the ship] came to rest on the [mountain of] Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people." (11:44)
